title: Battle animation fragment
description: An animations/database/battle/bin/*.bin (or .frg) file: which animations a skeleton plays for each animation slot in battle.

version.description: File format version: 4 in WARHAMMER III, 2 in WARHAMMER II, Three Kingdoms and Troy.

skeleton_name.description: Skeleton the animations are for, e.g. hu1.

table_name.description: Name of this fragment, as other files refer to it.

mount_table_name.description: Fragment of the mount, for riders.

locomotion_graph.description: Pack path of the locomotion graph (.xml).

blend_in_time.description: Blend time into this animation, in seconds.

selection_weight.description: Relative chance of picking this entry among entries of the same slot.

weapon_bone.description: Weapon bones used, e.g. "WEAPON_BONE_1 | WEAPON_BONE_2"; empty for none.

anim_refs.description: The animation files, with their metadata.

meta_file_path.description: Pack path of the .anm.meta file (events, splices).
